newsitem.title: CHINA: Bogus nuns and monks try to flee China.
newsitem.headline: Bogus nuns and monks try to flee China.

text.p: Suspicious Chinese customs officials checking the passport of a nervous monk stumbled on a group of 12 people disguised as Buddhist nuns and monks trying to sneak out of the country, state media said on Friday.
The 12, dressed in Buddhist robes and each clutching a Buddha statue, were arrested just a few steps from boarding a flight in southern Guangzhou bound for Hong Kong, the China News Service said.
"The 'monk' at the end of the queue handed in his passport, and when inspectors checked his documents, they found him nervous and that he did not look very much like a Buddhist monk," it said.

The group of 12 were all from southeastern Fujian province and had each paid between $10,000 and $30,000 for their counterfeit passports and a chance to reach the United States -- the ultimate goal of their abortive journey, it said.
